video.title: Mountain Weather Update 11/4, Meteorologist Chris Tomer

description:
Atmospheric River setup 11/5-11/15 for PNW/BC then eventually CA Sierra.  Rain/snow lines will be critical with mid-mountain and higher receiving most of the snow accumulation and rain at lower elevations.  This pattern might affect Interior Rockies on/after 11/13 with snow accumulation.  
Small, fast moving area of low pressure crosses UT/CO 11/4-11/5 with light to moderate snow accumulation.
